name: Brawler
description: Swings for power, lacks technical defense.

name: Counter-Striker
description: Waits for mistakes, precise and fast.

name: Submission Artist
description: Elite on the ground, weak on the feet.

name: Wrestler
description: Dominant takedowns and control, average striking.

name: Kickboxer
description: Fast hands and feet, good cardio.

name: Balanced
description: No major weaknesses, no major strengths.

name: Boxer
description: Elite hands, limited kicks and grappling.

name: Pressure Fighter
description: Never stops moving forward, endless cardio.

name: Submission Defender
description: Nearly impossible to submit, but lacks offense.

name: Ring General
description: Controls distance and octagon, high Fight IQ.

name: Clinch Specialist
description: Dominates in the clinch, average elsewhere.
